newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Danish 96 c/a surplus put at 10.3 bln DKK.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Danish 96 c/a surplus put at 10.3 bln DKK.

text.p: Denmark's Economy Ministry said on Monday that it expected the current account to show a 10.3 billion crown surplus at the end of 1996 and 10.8 billion crowns in 1997, compared to 8.1 billion crowns in 1995.
The figures in the ministry's latest economic survey, compared with a 10.0 billion crown surplus forecast for 1996 and 11.5 billion crowns for 1997 in its last survey in August.
